meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过知识图谱问答理解代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解不熟悉的代码库或审查代码逻辑。
copy.tagline_en: Understand codebases through knowledge graph Q&A
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand unfamiliar code or review code logic.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会读取项目中的知识图谱文件，根据你的问题搜索相关代码节点、函数、类等，并解释它们之间的关系和所属架构层。
howto.when: 当你想了解项目代码的结构、功能或组件间关系时，可以提出具体问题。

say.text: 这个项目中 main.py 文件的作用是什么？

say.note: Claude 会查找相关边，列出依赖关系。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the project's knowledge graph file, searches for relevant code nodes (files, functions, classes, etc.) based on your query, and explains their relationships and architectural layers.
howto.when_en: When you need to understand the structure, functionality, or relationships within a codebase, ask a specific question about it.

say_en.text: What does the main.py file do in this project?
say_en.note: Claude searches the graph for the main.py node and answers.

say_en.text: Which modules does the UserService class depend on?
say_en.note: Claude finds related edges and lists dependencies.
